title: Camouflaged nanorobots target and regulate macrophage subcellular organelle crosstalk patterns to promote neural regeneration.
authors: Guo, Qiangqiang; Wang, Wei; Jiang, Xinzhao; Tang, Jincheng; Cai, Feng; Wang, Wenbo; Zhang, Lichen; Li, Ziang; Huang, Yiyang; Wu, Jie; Zhou, Liang; Jiang, Haochen; Zhu, Yiwei; Cai, Guhao; Lin, Ziyu; Gu, Yong; Zhu, Xuesong; Chen, Liang; Xi, Kun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究巨噬细胞亚细胞器互作与纳米机器人调控，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Macrophage (Mphi) phenotypic transformation is crucial in determining spinal cord injury (SCI) outcomes. However, the suborganelle crosstalk mechanisms-particularly between the endoplasmic reticulum (ER) and mitochondria-that mediate Mphi subgroup conversion during SCI remain underexplored. We aim to integrate niche intervention strategies and omics sequencing to investigate the effects of the metabolic crosstalk between ER stress (ERS) and mitochondria. Subsequently, we develop a dual-targeted camouflaged nanorobot (BP@D/N) that can reach the SCI site via systemic circulation and selectively interact with Mphi. We observe that Ero1alpha-mediated Ca(2+) shuttling is an important mechanism for locking the inflammatory phenotype of Mphi. Blocking the Ero1alpha/MAMs/mtCa(2+) axis suppresses mtDNA release and downregulates the cGAS-STING-NFkappaB signaling cascade, thus promoting M2 polarization and neural repair. Our study clarifies the regulatory mechanism of Mphi transformation-associated suborganelle crosstalk and offers a paradigm for reconstructing the dynamic balance of immune-neural interactions in the SCI microenvironment for effective repair. It offers a scientifically grounded and translational approach to overcoming the clinical challenge of irreversible SCI.
abstract_zh: 巨噬细胞（Mphi）表型转化在决定脊髓损伤（SCI）结局中至关重要。然而，介导SCI期间Mphi亚群转化的亚细胞器串扰机制——特别是内质网（ER）与线粒体之间的串扰——仍未得到充分探索。我们旨在整合微环境干预策略和组学测序，研究内质网应激（ERS）与线粒体之间代谢串扰的影响。随后，我们开发了一种双靶向伪装纳米机器人（BP@D/N），可通过体循环到达SCI部位，并选择性地与Mphi相互作用。我们观察到Ero1alpha介导的Ca(2+)穿梭是锁定Mphi炎症表型的重要机制。阻断Ero1alpha/MAMs/mtCa(2+)轴可抑制mtDNA释放并下调cGAS-STING-NFkappaB信号级联，从而促进M2极化和神经修复。我们的研究阐明了Mphi转化相关亚细胞器串扰的调控机制，并为重建SCI微环境中免疫-神经相互作用的动态平衡以实现有效修复提供了范式。它为克服不可逆SCI的临床挑战提供了一种科学依据充分且可转化的方法。
